claims.summary: CourseIR v1 normalizes and validates a dense course source with source-ledger, concept, lesson, assessment, repair-path, and coverage-ledger checks.
The structured-output prompt contract asks providers for compact semantic atoms instead of final artifact prose.
The CourseIR planner chooses whole-course IR, lesson-block IR, global-plus-block IR, or fallback from model context and output capacity.
CurriculumOS accepts CourseIR and compiles selected artifacts deterministically through the existing CourseGraph/blueprint compiler with zero provider calls during compile.

CourseIR proof metadata records validation, coverage completeness, repair paths, and deterministic compile status for package assembly; default rollout still waits for side-by-side live quality and cost proof.

carryForward.next: Implement the flagged EduTool.dev CourseIR generation path and attach 5-, 8-, and 15-lesson side-by-side quality/cost proof before making CourseIR the default.
